messages.campaign_fixture.quest.replacements.desc: Meet the mentor. If the mentor is permanently removed, an authored successor carries the quest forward.
campaign_fixture.quest.replacements.offe: This fixture chooses one mentor and saves their identity. If they are permanently removed, another adult villager near the village takes over their quest and compatible scenes.
campaign_fixture.quest.replacements.remi: Visit the marked village. An unloaded mentor keeps their role. Only a recorded permanent loss starts the replacement.
campaign_fixture.quest.replacements.repo: Your progress continues with the current holder of this campaign role. The original binding and any replacement decisions remain saved.
